description: This file defines the ContentStreamEnumerator class, which implements an iterator for parsing and inspecting elements within a PDF content stream, including methods for moving between elements, checking conditions, and managing internal state.

classes.name: ContentStreamEnumerator
classes.description: Implements an enumerator for parsing PDF content streams, allowing navigation and inspection of stream elements.

classes.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.IState
classes.description: Interface representing the state of the enumerator, including position, current element, and length.

classes.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.State
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IState, maintaining the current parsing position and element details.

classes.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.Element
classes.description: Represents a parsed element within the content stream, storing its position and string value.

classes.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.EndOfStreamElement
classes.description: Special class indicating the end of the content stream.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the enumerator to the next element in the content stream.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.MovePrevious
methods.description: Moves the enumerator to the previous element.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.MoveNext(int steps)
methods.description: Moves forward by a specified number of elements.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.MovePrevious(int steps)
methods.description: Moves backward by a specified number of elements.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.Move(Func<string, bool> check, int steps, bool countMatchesOnly, bool backwards)
methods.description: Generic move method with condition checking and direction control.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.GetState
methods.description: Returns a clone of the current enumerator state.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.SetState
methods.description: Restores the enumerator to a given state.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.Reset
methods.description: Resets the enumerator to its initial state.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.IsWhiteSpace
methods.description: Checks if a character is whitespace.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.GetLengthOfCurrentElement
methods.description: Calculates the length of the current element based on content stream syntax.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.CreateElement
methods.description: Creates an element object from a position in the content stream.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator.SetCurrent
methods.description: Updates the current state with a new element.
